goal: Lets the GUI (and other future callers) load a UTXO snapshot through a clean node interface instead of touching chainstate internals directly.
Adds progress notifications during snapshot loading so users see feedback instead of a frozen UI.
Refactors the loadtxoutset RPC to go through the new interface.

No open objections; remaining comments were nits or already addressed by later pushes.

result.summary: This PR adds an interfaces::Snapshot abstraction so the GUI and other callers can load a UTXO snapshot through the node interface instead of manipulating ChainstateManager and file parsing directly, adds a SnapshotLoadProgress notification so the UI can show progress during loading, and refactors the loadtxoutset RPC to go through the new interface, consolidating file-open, metadata-parse, and activation logic in one place.
result.problem: Currently, loading an assumeutxo snapshot from the GUI would require GUI code to reach into chainstate internals directly, and there is no progress feedback during a multi-minute snapshot load, leaving GUI users staring at a frozen interface. Downstream GUI projects (Qt and QML) need this interface to add snapshot-loading support to their UIs.

resolved_concerns: ryanofsky's initial concern about passing an AutoFile across process boundaries was resolved by switching to a path-based Node::snapshot() API (ryanofsky, addressed by commit e79c50c).

ryanofsky questioned whether the Snapshot class was needed at all if it only had activate(); author kept it, arguing it will be needed once dump/generate snapshot functionality is exposed too (author, ryanofsky did not push back).
pinheadmz's concern that the progress notification fires too often (100M times on mainnet) was fixed by batching to every 100,000 coins (commit 8c932ff).

pinheadmz's several code-review comments about redundant file-parsing/error-code logic in the RPC handler were addressed across commits 328fef6 and af0c253, ending with a single activate() call and unified error surfacing.
fanquake's CI failure (unused variable warning on Windows) was fixed in commit 8bc4035.

result.card: This PR adds an interfaces::Snapshot abstraction so the GUI (and other future callers) can load a UTXO snapshot through the node interface instead of touching ChainstateManager and file parsing directly, adds a progress notification so a GUI can show feedback during the multi-minute load, and refactors the loadtxoutset RPC to route through the same interface. It serves the multiprocess project's goal of decoupling GUI operations from node internals, and is already exercised by draft Qt and QML GUI branches (gui#870, gui-qml#488) that add snapshot loading to those interfaces. Review has been substantive: ryanofsky shaped the interface design over several iterations, pinheadmz gave a code review ACK calling it the right way to expose this to GUI users after a performance concern (100M notification calls per snapshot) was fixed by batching, and sedited gave an approach ACK. The PR needs a rebase, has been force-pushed 17 times over more than a year, and currently shows a dirty mergeable state, so review should wait for a fresh push. No open objections remain, and the change also touches kernel notifications and RPC error-code behavior as secondary effects.
